statement: Marco Rossi proposed to Lena Fischer and Robert Kahn that Phase 2 deliver produce and dairy first, then chilled ready meals, then bakery, as three smaller go-lives rather than all four fresh categories in one go-live.
value: three waves: produce and dairy, then chilled ready meals, then bakery

statement: Marco Rossi stated that Phase 2 covered four fresh categories.
fact_key: number of fresh categories in Phase 2

statement: Marco Rossi proposed that the three Phase 2 go-lives be roughly six weeks apart.
Marco Rossi stated that the advantage of three waves was that value started landing earlier and each wave de-risked the next.
value: earlier value, each wave de-risks the next

statement: Marco Rossi stated that the disadvantage of three waves was more cutover events and a longer total elapsed time, which was in tension with the twelve-month window.
value: more cutovers, longer elapsed time, tension with twelve-month window

statement: Marco Rossi stated that if the three-wave sequencing worked for Lena Fischer and Robert Kahn, RELEX would build the Phase 2 plan around it.
value: plan to be built around three waves if accepted

statement: Ana Duarte stated that the three-wave approach was what RELEX was building towards for Phase 2.
Ana Duarte asked Nadia Haddad to sketch the UAT plan on the basis of the three-wave approach.
Nadia Haddad agreed to sketch the UAT plan on the three-wave basis.
responds_to: Ana Duarte's request that Nadia Haddad sketch the UAT plan on the three-wave basis

statement: Nadia Haddad asked Ana Duarte whether Acme had actually confirmed three waves for Phase 2.
Nadia Haddad stated that she had looked back through the thread and could not see a reply from Lena Fischer or Robert Kahn to the three-wave proposal.
value: no reply from Lena Fischer or Robert Kahn in thread

statement: Ana Duarte passed Nadia Haddad's question of whether Acme had confirmed three waves to Marco Rossi.
Marco Rossi recalled that the three-wave sequencing was discussed verbally in the June steering and that nobody pushed back.
value: discussed verbally in June steering, no pushback

statement: Marco Rossi stated that he would treat the three-wave sequencing as agreed.
value: treated as agreed by Marco Rossi

statement: Lena Fischer recalled that in the go/no-go meeting on Monday it was stated that Acme had agreed a three-wave rollout for fresh.
fact_key: statement of three-wave agreement at go/no-go meeting

statement: Lena Fischer stated that she did not remember agreeing to a three-wave rollout and that Robert Kahn certainly did not agree to it.
value: not agreed by Lena Fischer or Robert Kahn

statement: Lena Fischer recalled that what Acme agreed was fresh as Phase 2 in one delivery.
Lena Fischer stated that three waves meant three cutovers and pushed the last one well past the ROI window.
value: three cutovers, last one well past ROI window

statement: Lena Fischer recalled that Robert Kahn had been saying since March of the previous year that the rollout must not push past the ROI window.
value: raised by Robert Kahn since March last year

statement: Lena Fischer asked Marco Rossi to point her at where the three-wave rollout was agreed.
Marco Rossi stated that he could not point to where the three-wave rollout was agreed and that he had looked.

Marco Rossi corrected his earlier position by stating that the three-wave rollout was discussed in the June steering but was not minuted as a decision, that RELEX built the plan on it, and that this was RELEX's error rather than a misunderstanding.
value: discussed in June steering, not minuted, RELEX error
corrects: Marco Rossi's August statement that the three-wave sequencing should be treated as agreed because it was discussed in the June steering and nobody pushed back

statement: Marco Rossi stated that what was decided at the go/no-go meeting on Monday was two deliveries, not three: produce, dairy and chilled ready meals together in December, and bakery separately as its own workstream.
value: two deliveries: produce, dairy and chilled ready meals in December; bakery separately

statement: Marco Rossi stated that the two-delivery decision was what was in the go/no-go record.
fact_key: go/no-go record content on rollout sequencing

statement: Marco Rossi stated that anyone who said three waves in the go/no-go meeting was repeating a plan that had not been agreed with Lena Fischer.
fact_key: statement of three-wave agreement at go/no-go meeting

statement: Marco Rossi stated that he had asked Ana Duarte to reissue the Phase 2 plan on the two-delivery basis that day.
fact_key: reissue of Phase 2 plan on two-delivery basis

statement: Lena Fischer confirmed that two deliveries was what she understood for Phase 2.
